roles.functionStatement: Establish, document and defend what a proposed action's effects are and which review it requires, so that the deciding official acts on a defensible record.

instruments.label: NEPA as amended by the Fiscal Responsibility Act of 2023
Removal of CEQ NEPA implementing regulations (40 CFR 1500-1508)
Seven County Infrastructure Coalition v. Eagle County
Department of the Interior NEPA procedures and the DOI NEPA Handbook
USDA NEPA procedures (7 CFR part 1b); Forest Service 36 CFR part 220 rescinded
FAST-41 (Title 41 of the FAST Act) and the Federal Permitting Improvement Steering Council

majorDuties.duty: Conduct environmental impact review of proposed actions

tasks.statement: Prepare an environmental assessment of a proposed action, analyzing the reasonably foreseeable effects of the action and its alternatives within the procedure's page and time limits
Scope the review of a proposed action with cooperating agencies and the public, setting the purpose, alternatives and effects boundaries the analysis will cover
Verify AI-drafted sections of an environmental document against the project record, correcting unsupported statements and recording which text was machine-drafted

majorDuties.duty: Select, justify and document the appropriate level of environmental review

tasks.statement: Determine whether a proposed action requires an environmental assessment or a full impact statement, documenting the significance reasoning in the project record
Screen a proposed action against the agency's exclusion categories and extraordinary-circumstance criteria, recording the screening result and its basis for the official
Review automated exclusion-screening results for a batch of routine actions, confirming or overriding each flagged extraordinary circumstance

majorDuties.duty: Coordinate lead, cooperating and participating agencies to a shared schedule

tasks.statement: Coordinate review steps with other agencies holding authority over the same action, so that duplicated analyses and conflicting requirements are identified early
Update public milestone and dashboard entries for a covered project, reconciling each entry against agency source documents every reporting period

majorDuties.duty: Build and maintain a defensible administrative record

tasks.statement: Index documents into the administrative record with dates, authors and provenance labels, marking which content was produced with AI assistance
Confirm that every substantive comment in a docket has a reasoned response, sampling machine-grouped comments for unique points the grouping missed

majorDuties.duty: Analyze regulatory, planning and public-comment text at scale with traceable citations

tasks.statement: Code a public comment set into themes with machine assistance, tracing every coded statement to its source passage before summarizing for decision-makers.
Extract requirements from a plan or permit into a table with machine assistance, verifying each row against the cited page and paragraph.

majorDuties.duty: Validate AI-generated work products before professional use

tasks.statement: Sample machine-grouped public comments to confirm that substantive and unique comments were not merged away before responses are drafted.

majorDuties.duty: Review effects of proposed actions on historic properties and resolve them through consultation

tasks.statement: Define the area of potential effects for a proposed undertaking, documenting the direct and indirect effect pathways that justify its boundary
Assess whether a proposed action would adversely affect each eligible property, recording the criteria and evidence applied to each finding

majorDuties.duty: Assess effects on protected species and conduct interagency consultation on proposed actions

tasks.statement: Prepare a biological assessment for a proposed action, stating the effects determination for each listed species and critical habitat with supporting evidence
Review an effects determination drafted with AI assistance against the species and project records, correcting each conclusion the records do not support
Compile species and habitat occurrence information for an action area, documenting the sources and survey dates used for each listed species

majorDuties.duty: Analyze cumulative burdens and distributional effects of environmental decisions

tasks.statement: Screen a proposed project's area for existing environmental and health burdens using screening indicators, recording each indicator's source, date and known limitations

majorDuties.duty: Design proportionate public engagement when participation is discretionary

tasks.statement: Write an engagement plan stating who will be engaged, by which methods and when, and why that scope fits the decision
